source: Uncommitted integration work; final release must repeat the checks at its exact integration SHA.
command: npx tsx --test --test-concurrency=1 tests/event-participant-import.test.ts tests/event-guests-db.test.ts tests/account-removal-db.test.ts tests/player-statistics-db.test.ts tests/player-statistics.test.ts
checks: CSV preview writes no roster or guest profiles; reports duplicate/invalid/ambiguous rows and missing headers, quoted separators/newlines and limits. Apply validates the captured event revision and rechecks current accounts/ACL, then inserts reviewed rows exactly once. Revoked coorganizer cannot replay an earlier success.

Event-scoped guest UUID and public label are separate from authenticated accounts and hidden from the global player directory. Local real manager guest actions carry actedForGuest in audit; one guest confirmation cannot authenticate the account opponent.
Guest stale offline command preserves canonical visits, opens a real paused conflict, replays idempotently and requires an explicit manager reason; guestId is part of the command identity.

Actual personal guest winner is proposed by organizer, accepted by the named own account, shown once in own profile history/statistics and as a tournament win. Canonical player/winner/guest markers and match UUID remain unchanged. Claimed GET match has every permission false, no invite, no write or event membership.

Approved actual club guest winner preserves its real first place. The actual member keeps second-place seven points; guest has no circuit account or rating source even when allowGuests is true. Claim and repeated finalization do not change generation or retroactively award points.

Expired raw CSV is physically removed with bounded privileged purge, cached preview receipt loses names and becomes explicitly expired, direct runtime DELETE is denied. Normal account erasure also removes a different organizer preview by stable account ID/unique username.

An actual claimed privacy-worker erasure anonymizes accepted guest labels and stable-ID snapshots while preserving canonical IDs/winner/result and zero retroactive ranking. Web role and isolated worker cannot call the helper directly. Existing privacy and profile statistics regressions pass.

checksAdditional.eslint: Scoped guest/import/statistics module and test lint passed without warnings

limitations: No full nine-starter two-guest native/desktop evening or physical device acceptance claimed.
Hosted migrations/deployments and external delivery not performed by this evidence.
